title: Tower and antenna safety
blurb: The big idea before the cards.

lines.caption: On a tower, the big danger is a fall. Climbers wear an approved harness and stay tied off at all times.
lines.label: always tied off

lines.caption: And nobody climbs alone. A helper on the ground watches, and can call for help.
lines.label: never alone

lines.caption: Keep antennas far from power lines. If one falls, no part may come within ten feet, about three meters, of the wires.
lines.label: ten feet clear

lines.caption: Guy lines hold the tower steady. A safety wire stops their turnbuckles from shaking loose.
lines.label: no loosening

lines.caption: And a tower needs a short, direct path to earth, so lightning goes into the ground and not into your house.
lines.label: a path to earth
